answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 185 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is recorded against the ocean challenge, the glacier audit can replay the horizon history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 3581 identities would post 2782 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
